entry.name: mc.op~
entry.digest: Apply arithmetic operators to a multichannel signal
entry.description: The mc.op~ object, similar to jit.planeop, performs one of several arithmetic operations combining each sample of a multichannel input to produce a single-channel output.

attributes.name: op
attributes.digest: Operator used to calculate the combined output signal
attributes.description: Theobject can apply one of several operators to all channels of a connected multichannel signal. Each operator calculates the nth output sample on the basis of an operation on the nth sample of each input channel.

choices.label: Each sample of the output is the average of corresponding samples in each input channel.
Each sample of the output is the sum of corresponding samples in each input channel.
Each sample of the output is produced by multiplying all corresponding samples in each input channel.
Each sample of the output is produced by finding the minimum value of corresponding samples in each input channel.
Each sample of the output is produced by finding the maximum value of corresponding samples in each input channel.
